LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_ONE.title: 對話 · Dialogue
LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_ONE.setting: 在便利商店 · At the convenience store

text.traditional: 朋子，臺灣的便利商店真的太神奇了！不僅能買東西，還能繳水電費、寄包裹，甚至還能買高鐵票！
text.simplified: 朋子，台湾的便利商店真的太神奇了！不仅能买东西，还能缴水电费、寄包裹，甚至还能买高铁票！
text.english: Tomoko, Taiwan's convenience stores are really amazing! Not only can you buy things, but you can also pay utility bills, send packages, and even buy high-speed rail tickets!

text.traditional: 是啊，臺灣的超商密度可以說是世界第一呢。走幾步路就有一家，肚子餓了隨時都能買到熱騰騰的便當。
text.simplified: 是啊，台湾的超商密度可以说是世界第一呢。走几步路就有一家，肚子饿了随时都能买到热騰騰的便当。
text.english: Yes, Taiwan's convenience store density is practically number one in the world. There's one every few steps, and when you are hungry you can buy piping hot bento boxes anytime.

text.traditional: 我剛來臺灣的時候，看到店員一會兒煮咖啡，一會兒幫客人微波便當，一會兒又幫忙結帳，真是嚇了一跳！
text.simplified: 我刚来台湾的时候，看到店员一会儿煮咖啡，一会儿帮客人微波便当，一会儿又帮忙结帐，真是吓了一跳！
text.english: When I first came to Taiwan, seeing the clerk brewing coffee one moment, microwaving bento for customers the next, and helping check out right after, I was really astonished!

text.traditional: 臺灣的超商店員樣樣精通，工作非常辛苦。
text.simplified: 台湾的超商店员样样精通，工作非常辛苦。
text.english: Taiwan's convenience store clerks master everything; their work is very hardworking.

text.traditional: 你今天也是來便利商店繳費的嗎？
text.simplified: 你今天也是来便利商店缴费的吗？
text.english: Did you come to the convenience store to pay bills today too?

text.traditional: 不是，我是順便來拿網購的包裹，順便買杯冰美式咖啡。
text.simplified: 不是，我是顺便来拿网购的包裹，顺便买杯冰美式咖啡。
text.english: No, I came by the way to pick up an online shopping parcel, and pick up an iced Americano while I'm at it.

text.traditional: 我本來想回家煮晚餐，但今天加班太累了，我看就算了吧，在超商買個便當吃算了。
text.simplified: 我本来想回家煮晚餐，但今天加班太累了，我看就算了吧，在超商买个便当吃算了。
text.english: I originally wanted to go home and cook dinner, but I worked overtime and was too tired today. I guess never mind, I might as well just buy a bento at the convenience store.

text.traditional: 哈哈，偶爾吃一次沒關係啦。走，我們一起進去吹冷氣選便當！
text.simplified: 哈哈，偶爾吃一次没关系啦。走，我们一起进去吹冷气选便当！
text.english: Haha, having it once in a while is fine. Come on, let's go inside, enjoy the air conditioning and pick a bento!

LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_TWO.title: 短文 · 臺灣超商的生活樂趣 · Convenience Store Life in Taiwan

text.traditional: 在臺灣，便利商店已經成為人們日常生活中不可缺少的一部分。
text.simplified: 在台湾，便利商店已经成为人们日常生活中不可缺少的一部分。
text.english: In Taiwan, convenience stores have become an indispensable part of people's daily lives.

text.traditional: 許多外國人來到臺灣，第一件印象深刻的事就是街頭巷尾隨處可見的超商。
text.simplified: 许多外国人来到台湾，第一件印象深刻的事就是街头巷尾随处可见的超商。
text.english: When many foreigners arrive in Taiwan, the first deep impression they have is the convenience stores seen everywhere on street corners.

text.traditional: 人們經過一整天忙碌的工作後，走進燈光明亮的便利商店，喝一杯香濃的咖啡，心情就放鬆了下來。
text.simplified: 人们经过一整天忙碌的工作后，走进灯光明亮的便利商店，喝一杯香浓的咖啡，心情就放松了下来。
text.english: After a busy day of work, people walk into the brightly lit convenience store and drink an aromatic coffee, relaxing their mood.

text.traditional: 現代人常用手機 App 來累積超商點數，兌換各種實用的生活用品或美食。
text.simplified: 现代人常用手机 App 来累积超商点数，兌换各种实用的生活用品或美食。
text.english: Modern people frequently use mobile apps to accumulate convenience store points and redeem various practical daily necessities or delicacies.

text.traditional: 便利商店不僅提供了極大的生活便利，更為現代都市人的生活增添了許多溫暖與樂趣。
text.simplified: 便利商店不仅提供了极大的生活便利，更为现代都市人的生活增添了许多温暖与乐趣。
text.english: Convenience stores not only provide immense daily convenience, but also add warmth and joy to the lives of modern urbanites.

LESSON_TWO_PART_ONE.title: Grammar 1–4 · Convenience Stores Are So Convenient

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Use rhetorical questions with 不是…嗎 to confirm or emphasize a known fact.
grammarPages.explanation: This rhetorical pattern asks a question to confirm something the speaker believes is true, or to gently remind the listener.

items.question: Does 不是…嗎 ask a genuine information question?
items.answer: No. 不是…嗎 is a rhetorical question reminding or confirming something obvious to the speaker.

right.english: What time did you arrive yesterday?

items.question: Can 不是…嗎 take question words like 什麼 inside?
items.answer: No. Rhetorical 不是…嗎 frames a complete statement to seek agreement; drop question words.

right.pinyin: Zhè bú shì hǎo dōngxi ma?

text.traditional: 你不是早就計畫好要出國了嗎？怎麼現在才請假呢？
text.simplified: 你不是早就计画好要出国了吗？怎么现在才请假呢？
text.pinyin: Nǐ bú shì zǎojiù jìhuà hǎo yào chūguó le ma? Zěnme xiànzài cái qǐngjià ne?
text.english: Didn't you plan to go abroad long ago? Why are you asking for leave only now?

text.traditional: 這家超商不是二十四小時營業的嗎？
text.simplified: 这家超商不是二十四小时营业的吗？
text.pinyin: Zhè jiā chāoshāng bú shì èrshísì xiǎoshí yíngyè de ma?
text.english: Isn't this convenience store open 24 hours?

text.traditional: 他不是上個月才剛換新工作嗎？
text.simplified: 他不是上个月才刚换新工作吗？
text.pinyin: Tā bú shì shàng ge yuè cái gāng huàn xīn gōngzuò ma?
text.english: Didn't he just change to a new job last month?

grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: Choose the best option to complete the statement.

questions.prompt: A: 我找不到錢包。 B: 你的錢包___在背包裡___？

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Express doing a secondary action on the way using 順便.
grammarPages.explanation: 順便 indicates that an action is done conveniently while doing the primary task, without requiring extra trip or special effort.

items.question: Can 順便 be used for a special, deliberate trip?
items.answer: No. 順便 means 'in passing / on the way' without going out of your way; for a deliberate trip, say 特地 or 專門.

right.pinyin: Wǒ tēdì zuò fēijī qù kàn nǐ.
right.english: I specially flew to visit you.

items.question: Where is 順便 placed in relation to the secondary action?
items.answer: 順便 sits immediately before the secondary verb phrase that you perform on the way.

right.pinyin: Wǒ qù chāoshāng shùnbiàn mǎi niúnǎi.
right.english: I went to the store and conveniently bought milk.

text.traditional: 紀先生下班經過朋友家時，順便把幫朋友買的筆電送去了。
text.simplified: 纪先生下班经过朋友家时，顺便把帮朋友买的笔电送去了。
text.pinyin: Jì xiānsheng xiàbān jīngguò péngyǒu jiā shí, shùnbiàn bǎ bāng péngyǒu mǎi de bǐdiàn sòng qù le.
text.english: When Mr. Ji passed by his friend's house after work, he conveniently dropped off the laptop he bought for him.

text.traditional: 你去便利商店的時候，能不能順便幫我買一杯熱拿鐵？
text.simplified: 你去便利商店的时候，能不能顺便帮我买一杯热拿铁？
text.pinyin: Nǐ qù biànlì shāngdiàn de shíhòu, néng bù néng shùnbiàn bāng wǒ mǎi yì bēi rè nátiě?
text.english: When you go to the convenience store, could you conveniently buy a hot latte for me?

text.traditional: 小龍跟顧客介紹新產品的時候，都會順便說說他自己使用的經驗。
text.simplified: 小龙跟顾客介绍新产品的时候，都会顺便说说他自己使用的经验。
text.pinyin: Xiǎolóng gēn gùkè jièshào xīn chǎnpǐn de shíhòu, dōu huì shùnbiàn shuōshuō tā zìjǐ shǐyòng de jīngyàn.
text.english: When Xiaolong introduces new products to customers, he always shares his own usage experience along the way.

grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: Choose the best option to complete the statement.

questions.prompt: 你去郵局寄信時，可以___幫我買幾張郵票嗎？

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Describe two alternating actions or rapidly changing conditions using 一會兒…一會兒….
grammarPages.explanation: This structure describes alternating actions occurring in quick succession, or states changing repeatedly.
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 一會兒 + Action 1 + 一會兒 + Action 2

items.question: Can 一會兒…一會兒… describe simultaneous actions?
items.answer: No. It describes alternating actions in quick succession; for simultaneous actions, use 一邊…一邊….
items.wrongTraditional: 他一會兒吃飯一會兒看電視。
items.wrongSimplified: 他一会儿吃饭一会儿看电视。

right.traditional: 他一邊吃飯一邊看電視。
right.simplified: 他一边吃饭一边看电视。
right.pinyin: Tā yìbiān chīfàn yìbiān kàn diànshì.
right.english: He is eating while watching television.

items.question: Can 一會兒 be used with a single verb?
items.answer: In this pattern, both parts must repeat (一會兒 A，一會兒 B) to show alternation.

right.traditional: 他今天一會兒哭一會兒笑。
right.simplified: 他今天一会儿哭一会儿笑。
right.pinyin: Tā jīntiān yíhuìr kū yíhuìr xiào.
right.english: Today he cries one moment and laughs the next.

text.traditional: 今天整天下雨，風一會兒大，一會兒小，這樣的天氣出門真麻煩！
text.simplified: 今天整天下雨，风一会儿大，一会儿小，这样的天气出门真麻烦！
text.pinyin: Jīntiān zhěng tiān xiàyǔ, fēng yìhuǐr dà, yìhuǐr xiǎo, zhèyàng de tiānqì chūmén zhēn máfan!
text.english: It rained all day today; the wind was strong one moment and weak the next. Going out in such weather is really troublesome!

text.traditional: 店員一會兒幫客人微波便當，一會兒忙著結帳，一刻都停不下來。
text.simplified: 店员一会儿帮客人微波便当，一会儿忙着结帐，一刻都停不下来。
text.pinyin: Diànyuán yìhuǐr bāng kèrén wēibō biàndāng, yìhuǐr máng zhe jiézhàng, yí kè dōu tíng bù xiàlái.
text.english: The clerk microwaved bento for customers one moment, and bustled checking out the next, unable to stop for a second.

text.traditional: 妹妹做功課的時候很不專心，一會兒吃零食，一會兒玩手機。
text.simplified: 妹妹做功课的时候很不专心，一会儿吃零食，一会儿玩手机。
text.pinyin: Mèimei zuò gōngkè de shíhòu hěn bù zhuānxīn, yìhuǐr chī língshí, yìhuǐr wán shǒujī.
text.english: When my younger sister did homework she was very unfocused, eating snacks one minute and playing on her phone the next.

grammarPages.exercisePreview: Practice using 一會兒…一會兒… in context.
grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: Choose the best option to complete the statement.

questions.prompt: 山上的天氣變化真快，剛才還出大太陽，現在___下起雨來了。

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Give up a plan or accept a compromised situation using 算了.
grammarPages.explanation: 算了 indicates dropping a plan or settling for an alternative when facing difficulties or fatigue.

items.question: Can 算了 mean 'calculated correctly'?
items.answer: As an idiom, 算了 means 'forget it / let it drop'; to calculate, use 算好了.

right.pinyin: Zhè dào shùxué tí wǒ suàn hǎo le.
right.english: I have calculated this math problem.

items.question: Can 算了 precede a noun directly?
items.answer: 算了 is a predicate exclamation or clause-final marker; it never acts as a noun modifier.

right.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì jiù suànle ba.

text.traditional: 這幾天工作忙死了，晚上不想煮飯，我想就去便利商店買算了。
text.simplified: 这几天工作忙死了，晚上不想煮饭，我想就去便利商店买算了。
text.pinyin: Zhè jǐ tiān gōngzuò máng sǐ le, wǎnshàng bù xiǎng zhǔfàn, wǒ xiǎng jiù qù biànlì shāngdiàn mǎi suàn le.
text.english: Work has been crazy busy these past few days and I don't want to cook dinner; I think I'll just buy from the convenience store.

text.traditional: 外面雨下得這麼大，我看今天的爬山行程就算了吧。
text.simplified: 外面雨下得这么大，我看今天的爬山行程就算了吧。
text.pinyin: Wàimiàn yǔ xià de zhème dà, wǒ kàn jīntiān de páshān xíngchéng jiù suàn le ba.
text.english: It is raining so hard outside; I think we might as well cancel today's hiking itinerary.

text.traditional: 修這輛老舊的機車要花幾萬元，我看買台新的算了。
text.simplified: 修这辆老旧的机车要花几万元，我看买台新的算了。
text.pinyin: Xiū zhè liàng lǎojiù de jīchē yào huā jǐ wàn yuán, wǒ kàn mǎi tái xīn de suàn le.
text.english: Fixing this old scooter costs tens of thousands; I think buying a new one is better.

LESSON_TWO_PART_TWO.title: Grammar 5–7 · Convenience Stores Are So Convenient

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Emphasize stubbornness or an unyielding result using 就是.
grammarPages.explanation: 就是 here acts as an emphatic adverb indicating that something simply happens or fails despite repeated efforts.

items.question: Does emphatic 就是 mean 'A equals B'?
items.answer: Emphatic 就是 expresses stubborn insistence or refusal ('simply won't'); not the equational 'is'.

right.english: That book is indeed a dictionary.

items.question: Where does emphatic 就是 sit with negation 不?
items.answer: 就是 sits before 不 (就是不聽, 就是不去), emphasizing obstinate refusal.

text.traditional: 這個門我開了半天就是打不開，你過來看看。
text.simplified: 这个门我开了半天就是打不开，你过来看看。
text.pinyin: Zhège mén wǒ kāi le bàntiān jiùshì dǎ bù kāi, nǐ guòlái kànkan.
text.english: I tried to open this door for ages, but it just won't open; come and take a look.

text.traditional: 醫生勸他少喝點酒，但他就是不肯改掉這個壞習慣。
text.simplified: 医生劝他少喝点酒，但他就是不肯改掉这个坏习惯。
text.pinyin: Yīshēng quàn tā shǎo hē diǎn jiǔ, dàn tā jiùshì bù kěn gǎidiào zhège huài xíguàn.
text.english: The doctor advised him to drink less, but he simply refused to drop this bad habit.

text.traditional: 不管大家怎麼鼓勵他，他就是不願意上台表演。
text.simplified: 不管大家怎么鼓励他，他就是不愿意上台表演。
text.pinyin: Bùguǎn dàjiā zěnme gǔlì tā, tā jiùshì bú yuànyì shàngtái biǎoyǎn.
text.english: No matter how everyone encouraged him, he simply wouldn't perform on stage.

questions.prompt: 我找了半天，___找不到家裡的鑰匙。

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Express a result achieved through a process or time period using 經過.
grammarPages.explanation: 經過 indicates undergoing a certain process, experience, or period of time that leads to an outcome.

items.question: Can 經過 mean passing by a physical location?
items.answer: Yes, as a verb it means passing by; as a preposition here, it means 'through the process of'.

right.traditional: 經過超商時我想買東西。
right.simplified: 经过超商时我想买东西。
right.pinyin: Jīngguò chāoshāng shí wǒ xiǎng mǎi dōngxi.
right.english: When passing by the store, I wanted to buy something.

items.question: Can 經過 be followed immediately by an adjective without a process?
items.answer: 經過 introduces an experience or process, not an adjective attribute.

text.traditional: 他以前一句中文都不會說，才經過三個月，現在不但朋友多了，買東西也沒問題了。
text.simplified: 他以前一句中文都不会说，才经过三个月，现在不但朋友多了，买东西也没问题了。
text.pinyin: Tā yǐqián yí jù zhōngwén dōu bú huì shuō, cái jīngguò sān ge yuè, xiànzài búdàn péngyǒu duō le, mǎi dōngxi yě méi wèntí le.
text.english: Previously he couldn't speak a sentence of Chinese; after just three months, not only does he have more friends, but shopping is no problem either.

text.traditional: 我們社區的健身用品不夠，經過開會討論，決定下個月增加兩輛健身腳踏車。
text.simplified: 我们社区的健身用品不够，经过开会讨论，决定下个月增加两辆健身脚踏车。
text.pinyin: Wǒmen shèqū de jiànshēn yòngpǐn bú gòu, jīngguò kāihuì tǎolùn, juédìng xià ge yuè zēngjiā liǎng liàng jiànshēn jiǎotàchē.
text.english: Our community's gym gear is insufficient; through meeting discussions, we decided to add two exercise bikes next month.

text.traditional: 經過多年的實習與摸索，他終於成了一名受人尊敬的好導演。
text.simplified: 经过多年的实习与摸索，他终于成了一名受人尊敬的好导演。
text.pinyin: Jīngguò duō nián de shíxí yǔ mōsuǒ, tā zhōngyú chéng le yì míng shòu rén zūnjìng de hǎo dǎoyǎn.
text.english: Through many years of internship and exploration, he finally became a respected director.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Express the method or instrument used to achieve an objective using 用…來….
grammarPages.explanation: This structure indicates using a specific tool, method, or medium to perform an action or reach a goal.
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 用 + Tool / Method + 來 + Action

items.question: Can 來 be omitted in the 用…來… pattern?
items.answer: 來 links the instrument/means to the purpose; omitting it weakens the purposive connection.

right.pinyin: Tā yòng zhè zhī bǐ lái xiězì.
right.english: He uses this pen to write.

items.question: Can the purpose in 來 precede the tool in 用?
items.answer: No. The order is always Tool/Means first (用 X), then Purpose second (來 Y).

right.english: He uses a pen to write.

text.traditional: 現在手機的功能很強，很多人都用手機來處理日常事情。
text.simplified: 现在手机的功能很强，很多人都用手机来处理日常事情。
text.pinyin: Xiànzài shǒujī de gōngnéng hěn qiáng, hěn duō rén dōu yòng shǒujī lái chǔlǐ rìcháng shìqing.
text.english: Smartphones have powerful functions nowadays; many people use phones to handle daily affairs.

text.traditional: 孔子常用講故事的方式來告訴學生做人做事的道理。
text.simplified: 孔子常用讲故事的方式来告诉学生做人做事的道理。
text.pinyin: Kǒngzǐ cháng yòng jiǎng gùshì de fāngshì lái gàosù xuésheng zuòrén zuòshì de dàolǐ.
text.english: Confucius often used storytelling to teach students moral principles.

text.traditional: 現代人常用通訊軟體來跟世界各地的朋友保持聯繫。
text.simplified: 现代人常用通讯軟体来跟世界各地的朋友保持联繫。
text.pinyin: Xiàndàirén cháng yòng tōngxùn ruǎntǐ lái gēn shìjiè gèdì de péngyǒu bǎochí liánxì.
text.english: Modern people often use messaging apps to keep in touch with friends around the world.

dialogue.title: 短文 · 臺灣超商的生活樂趣 · Convenience Store Life in Taiwan

text.traditional: 在臺灣，便利商店已經成為人們日常生活中不可缺少的一部分。
text.simplified: 在台湾，便利商店已经成为人们日常生活中不可缺少的一部分。
text.english: In Taiwan, convenience stores have become an indispensable part of people's daily lives.

text.traditional: 許多外國人來到臺灣，第一件印象深刻的事就是街頭巷尾隨處可見的超商。
text.simplified: 许多外国人来到台湾，第一件印象深刻的事就是街头巷尾随处可见的超商。
text.english: When many foreigners arrive in Taiwan, the first deep impression they have is the convenience stores seen everywhere on street corners.

text.traditional: 人們經過一整天忙碌的工作後，走進燈光明亮的便利商店，喝一杯香濃的咖啡，心情就放鬆了下來。
text.simplified: 人们经过一整天忙碌的工作后，走进灯光明亮的便利商店，喝一杯香浓的咖啡，心情就放松了下来。
text.english: After a busy day of work, people walk into the brightly lit convenience store and drink an aromatic coffee, relaxing their mood.

text.traditional: 現代人常用手機 App 來累積超商點數，兌換各種實用的生活用品或美食。
text.simplified: 现代人常用手机 App 来累积超商点数，兌换各种实用的生活用品或美食。
text.english: Modern people frequently use mobile apps to accumulate convenience store points and redeem various practical daily necessities or delicacies.

text.traditional: 便利商店不僅提供了極大的生活便利，更為現代都市人的生活增添了許多溫暖與樂趣。
text.simplified: 便利商店不仅提供了极大的生活便利，更为现代都市人的生活增添了许多温暖与乐趣。
text.english: Convenience stores not only provide immense daily convenience, but also add warmth and joy to the lives of modern urbanites.
